chapter: New York and the Freedom Now years
title: Living and writing with Max
summary: In lean times she and Max wrote at the piano, and she learned composition from him and heard his Charlie Parker stories.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: we couldn't pay the phone bills and then rent wasn't so expensive and we would write and practice music in the apartment. Max would go to the piano and find a melody. He'd start out with one line and develop it. I learned from him how to compose a song and he cared so much for the music. Sometimes he would go to blows with the musicians over our principles, you know. They would fight like animals. Mm-hmm. Something that you feel that strongly about. He told me about Charlie Parker, the kind of person he was and little stories, you know, and I had a chance to meet Dizzy.
